name: login-camera
title: Login — camera preview
caption: The login screen shows the live front camera with a face outline. The webcam feed was automated with Aaron’s photo so recognition can match him.

name: login-recognizing
title: Login — recognizing
caption: After pressing “Recognize me”, the app computes the face descriptor of the frame and compares it to every member’s reference descriptor.

name: dashboard
title: Dashboard — home
caption: After logging in you land on your dashboard: a profile card with the welcome message and the two photo buttons, then “My Wishlist”, then “Everyone’s Wishlists”.

name: modal-face-login
title: Modal — Change face login photo
caption: This front-camera-only modal captures the selfie used to recognize you at login. It is stored separately from your profile picture and is never shown to anyone.

name: modal-profile
title: Modal — Change profile picture
caption: This modal captures the photo everyone sees next to your name in the directory. It has no effect on face login.

name: modal-add-empty
title: Modal — Add item (empty)
caption: The add-item form: required Item Name and Size, optional Purchase Link, optional Photo (Take photo or Upload), and the “Allow multiple gifts” toggle.

name: item-photo-camera
title: Modal — item photo camera
caption: The item photo camera opens inline with a Switch-camera button (top-right) to flip between the front and back camera when photographing a physical item.

name: modal-add-filled
title: Modal — add item with photo
caption: The completed form with the uploaded photo preview. On save the image is resized to at most 800px JPEG and uploaded to Supabase Storage.

name: my-wishlist
title: My Wishlist — populated
caption: Your wishlist with three items. Each row shows the item thumbnail (click to view full size), name, size, optional link, a “Multiple” toggle, and Edit/Delete actions.

name: modal-edit-item
title: Modal — Edit item
caption: Editing an existing item reuses the same form, prefilled with the current values and photo, with Replace/Remove photo controls.

name: directory-grid
title: Directory — grid view
caption: Everyone’s Wishlists in grid view (2–6 responsive columns). Each card shows the avatar, name, a 3-item preview, a favorite heart, and “See more” when there are more than 3 items.

name: user-card-preview
title: Directory — member card
caption: A member card in detail: avatar, favorite heart, the first three wishlist items, and a “See more” link that opens the full wishlist.

name: directory-list
title: Directory — list view
caption: The same directory in list view: each member becomes a full-width card, easier to scan on larger screens.

name: member-wishlist
title: Member wishlist — reserve
caption: Opening a member’s wishlist shows every item with a Reserve button. Reservation names are always hidden from the wishlist owner.

name: reserved
title: Member wishlist — reserved
caption: After reserving, the button becomes “Reserved by You — Unreserve”. Single-gift items can only be reserved once; multi-gift items can be shared by several people.

name: favorite
title: Directory — favorite a member
caption: Clicking the heart marks a member as your favorite (stored on your user record). The heart fills red so their card stands out.

name: lucky-one
title: Dashboard — the Lucky One
caption: If a member is flagged as the “lucky one” and you have see-the-lucky-one enabled, a card reveals who it is. The lucky member themselves sees a celebration banner.
